About Us - Binks | Premium Blouses, Kurtas, Shirts, Tops & More | Shop Online

Welcome to Binks, where style meets innovation in the most vibrant and sustainable way possible. Our journey began as a humble online tailor, catering to the diverse fashion needs of over 1 lakh Indian women. In that process, we uncovered a hidden gem - the power of precision.

Binks was born from the idea that every woman deserves clothing that fits flawlessly and reflects her unique style. With unwavering dedication, we harnessed the magic of technology to create 3D body measurements for our cherished customers. This data became the cornerstone of our evolution, enabling us to craft a truly comprehensive size chart that ensures you always find the perfect fit with us.

As we continued to grow and evolve, we knew it was time to embark on a new chapter. We have put the tailor's tape aside to bring you something even more exceptional. Leveraging the wealth of data we have accumulated, Binks is proud to introduce our own private label brands.

We believe that simplicity is the ultimate form of sophistication. That's why we primarily focus on categories like blouses, dresses, shorts, kurtas, and more. But what truly sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to color.

Binks aspires to be your ultimate destination for the widest range of colors in top wear for women. We understand that color is more than just a hue; it's an expression, an inspiration, a mood. Our mission is to empower you to explore this vibrant spectrum and find the shades that resonate with your individuality.

Quality and sustainability are at the core of our values. We take pride in offering you garments that not only make you look good but also feel good about your choices. Our fabrics are sourced responsibly, and our designs are created to withstand the test of time, both in terms of style and durability.

As we bid farewell to our tailoring days and step into a new era, we invite you to join us on this stylish journey. Binks is no longer just about fitting into clothes; it's about embracing your individuality, making sustainable choices, and expressing yourself through an array of colors and modern silhouettes.
